SET @v_log_message = '########## Start of procedure ##########';
        SET @v_description = '';
        SET @d_event_date = SYSDATETIME();
        EXEC PR_SCM_SYS_LOG_BATCH @v_program_name, @v_log_type, @n_log_count, @v_log_message, @v_description, @d_event_date;
        SET @v_log_message = NULL      /*-- <- 변수 재사용을 위하여 초기화해야함 --*/
        -- 시작 LOG  (END)

        -- 트랜잭션 (START)
        BEGIN TRANSACTION SAVE_DM_PLN_BP_FCST;

    --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
        BEGIN TRY
    -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- 

	DECLARE @ROW_COUNT INT
	SELECT @ROW_COUNT = COUNT(*) FROM STRING_SPLIT(@p_active_flag,'^')
	
		IF @p_DIVISION_ID = '^' 
		BEGIN
			SET @v_log_type = 'INVALID';

			SELECT N'입력값을 확인하세요.'

			SET @v_description = N'필수 입력값을 확인하세요.'

			GOTO err_rtn
		END  
	  

	 
    WHILE LEN(@p_DIVISION_ID) > 0
    --###############################################  #TEMP_BP_FCST_C 테이블에 split후 insert (START)
    BEGIN
        -------------------------------------------
        BEGIN
   
			DECLARE  @index_active_flag          INT
			DECLARE  @index_DIVISION_ID          INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_VERSION_NO           INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_SCM_SITE_ID          INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_END_CUSTOMER         INT
			DECLARE  @index_PROJECT_CODE         INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_ITEM_ID              INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_CURRENCY             INT
			DECLARE  @index_PLANT_SITE_ID        INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_FCST_TYPE            INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_DOM_EXP              INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_INCOTERMS            INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_CELL_PROD_SITE       INT
			DECLARE  @index_MEASURE              INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_YYYYMM               INT -- PK
			DECLARE  @index_QTY                  INT
			DECLARE  @index_DEPT_ID              INT
			DECLARE  @index_BIZ_TYPE             INT
			DECLARE  @index_CREATED_BY           INT
			DECLARE  @index_LAST_UPDATED_BY      INT
			
			SET @index_active_flag          = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_active_flag        )
			SET @index_DIVISION_ID          = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_DIVISION_ID        ) -- PK
			SET @index_VERSION_NO           = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_VERSION_NO         ) -- PK
			SET @index_SCM_SITE_ID          = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_SCM_SITE_ID        ) -- PK
			SET @index_END_CUSTOMER         = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_END_CUSTOMER       )
			SET @index_PROJECT_CODE         = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_PROJECT_CODE       ) -- PK
			SET @index_ITEM_ID              = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_ITEM_ID            ) -- PK
			SET @index_CURRENCY             = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_CURRENCY           )
			SET @index_PLANT_SITE_ID        = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_PLANT_SITE_ID      ) -- PK
			SET @index_FCST_TYPE            = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_FCST_TYPE          ) -- PK
			SET @index_DOM_EXP              = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_DOM_EXP            ) -- PK
			SET @index_INCOTERMS            = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_INCOTERMS          ) -- PK
			SET @index_CELL_PROD_SITE       = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_CELL_PROD_SITE     ) -- PK
			SET @index_MEASURE              = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_MEASURE            ) -- PK
			SET @index_YYYYMM               = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_YYYYMM             ) -- PK
			SET @index_QTY                  = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_QTY                )
			SET @index_DEPT_ID              = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_DEPT_ID            )
			SET @index_BIZ_TYPE             = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_BIZ_TYPE           )
			SET @index_CREATED_BY           = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_CREATED_BY         )
			SET @index_LAST_UPDATED_BY      = PATINDEX('%' + '^' + '%', @p_LAST_UPDATED_BY    )

        END 


        IF @in

dex_DIVISION_ID > 0
            -------------------------------------------
            BEGIN 
			
                SET @v_active_flag = SUBSTRING(@p_active_flag, 0, @index_active_flag)
                SET @p_active_flag = SUBSTRING(@p_active_flag, LEN(@v_active_flag + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_active_flag))

                SET @v_DIVISION_ID        = SUBSTRING(@p_DIVISION_ID       , 0, @index_DIVISION_ID       )
				SET @p_DIVISION_ID        = SUBSTRING(@p_DIVISION_ID       , LEN(@v_DIVISION_ID        + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_DIVISION_ID       ))

				SET @v_VERSION_NO         = SUBSTRING(@p_VERSION_NO        , 0, @index_VERSION_NO       )
				SET @p_VERSION_NO         = SUBSTRING(@p_VERSION_NO        , LEN(@v_VERSION_NO        + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_VERSION_NO       )) 

				SET @v_SCM_SITE_ID        = SUBSTRING(@p_SCM_SITE_ID       , 0, @index_SCM_SITE_ID       )
				SET @p_SCM_SITE_ID        = SUBSTRING(@p_SCM_SITE_ID       , LEN(@v_SCM_SITE_ID        + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_SCM_SITE_ID       ))

				SET @v_END_CUSTOMER       = SUBSTRING(@p_END_CUSTOMER      , 0, @index_END_CUSTOMER      )
				SET @p_END_CUSTOMER       = SUBSTRING(@p_END_CUSTOMER      , LEN(@v_END_CUSTOMER       + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_END_CUSTOMER      ))

				SET @v_PROJECT_CODE       = SUBSTRING(@p_PROJECT_CODE      , 0, @index_PROJECT_CODE      )
				SET @p_PROJECT_CODE       = SUBSTRING(@p_PROJECT_CODE      , LEN(@v_PROJECT_CODE       + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_PROJECT_CODE      ))
				
				SET @v_ITEM_ID            = SUBSTRING(@p_ITEM_ID           , 0, @index_ITEM_ID           )
				SET @p_ITEM_ID            = SUBSTRING(@p_ITEM_ID           , LEN(@v_ITEM_ID            + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_ITEM_ID           ))

				SET @v_CURRENCY           = SUBSTRING(@p_CURRENCY          , 0, @index_CURRENCY          )
				SET @p_CURRENCY           = SUBSTRING(@p_CURRENCY          , LEN(@v_CURRENCY           + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_CURRENCY          ))

				SET @v_PLANT_SITE_ID      = SUBSTRING(@p_PLANT_SITE_ID     , 0, @index_PLANT_SITE_ID     ) 
				SET @p_PLANT_SITE_ID      = SUBSTRING(@p_PLANT_SITE_ID     , LEN(@v_PLANT_SITE_ID       + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_PLANT_SITE_ID    ))

				SET @v_FCST_TYPE          = SUBSTRING(@p_FCST_TYPE         , 0, @index_FCST_TYPE         ) 
				SET @p_FCST_TYPE          = SUBSTRING(@p_FCST_TYPE         , LEN(@v_FCST_TYPE           + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_FCST_TYPE        ))

				SET @v_DOM_EXP            = SUBSTRING(@p_DOM_EXP           , 0, @index_DOM_EXP           ) 
				SET @p_DOM_EXP            = SUBSTRING(@p_DOM_EXP           , LEN(@v_DOM_EXP            + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_DOM_EXP           ))

				SET @v_INCOTERMS          = SUBSTRING(@p_INCOTERMS         , 0, @index_INCOTERMS         ) 
				SET @p_INCOTERMS          = SUBSTRING(@p_INCOTERMS         , LEN(@v_INCOTERMS          + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_INCOTERMS         ))

				SET @v_CELL_PROD_SITE            = SUBSTRING(@p_CELL_PROD_SITE           , 0, @index_CELL_PROD_SITE          ) 
				SET @p_CELL_PROD_SITE            = SUBSTRING(@p_CELL_PROD_SITE           , LEN(@v_CELL_PROD_SITE            + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_CELL_PROD_SITE           ))

				SET @v_MEASURE            = SUBSTRING(@p_MEASURE           , 0, @index_MEASURE           ) 
				SET @p_MEASURE            = SUBSTRING(@p_MEASURE           , LEN(@v_MEASURE            + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_MEASURE           )) 

				SET @v_YYYYMM             = SUBSTRING(@p_YYYYMM            , 0, @index_YYYYMM            ) 
				SET @p_YYYYMM             = SUBSTRING(@p_YYYYMM            , LEN(@v_YYYYMM             + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_YYYYMM            ))

				SET @v_QTY                = SUBSTRING(@p_QTY               , 0, @index_QTY               ) 
				SET @p_QTY                = SUBSTRING(@p_QTY               , LEN(@v_QTY                + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_QTY               ))

				SET @v_DEPT_ID            = SUBSTRING(@p_DEPT_ID           , 0, @index_DEPT_ID           ) 
				SET @p_DEPT_ID            = SUBSTRING(@p_DEPT_ID           , LEN(@v_DE

PT_ID            + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_DEPT_ID               ))

				SET @v_BIZ_TYPE           = SUBSTRING(@p_BIZ_TYPE          , 0, @index_BIZ_TYPE           ) 
				SET @p_BIZ_TYPE           = SUBSTRING(@p_BIZ_TYPE          , LEN(@v_BIZ_TYPE           + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_BIZ_TYPE               ))
				 
                SET @v_CREATED_BY  = SUBSTRING(@p_CREATED_BY , 0, @index_CREATED_BY )
				SET @p_CREATED_BY  = SUBSTRING(@p_CREATED_BY , LEN(@v_CREATED_BY  + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_CREATED_BY ))

                SET @v_LAST_UPDATED_BY  = SUBSTRING(@p_LAST_UPDATED_BY , 0, @index_LAST_UPDATED_BY )
                SET @p_LAST_UPDATED_BY  = SUBSTRING(@p_LAST_UPDATED_BY , LEN(@v_LAST_UPDATED_BY  + '^') + 1, LEN(@p_LAST_UPDATED_BY ))

				SET @v_CELL_PROD_SITE = REPLACE(@v_CELL_PROD_SITE, '^', '')
				IF (@v_CELL_PROD_SITE = '')
				BEGIN
					SET @v_CELL_PROD_SITE = '-'
				END
				IF (@v_DIVISION_ID = '40')
				BEGIN
					SET @v_END_CUSTOMER = '-'
				END 				 
	
               IF @index_DIVISION_ID > 1 
                  BEGIN 
					   INSERT INTO #TEMP_RESULTS (   
							 v_active_flag           
							,v_DIVISION_ID           
							,v_VERSION_NO            
							,v_PROJECT_CODE          
							,v_SCM_SITE_ID           
							,v_END_CUSTOMER          
							,v_PLANT_SITE_ID         
							,v_ITEM_ID               
							,v_DOM_EXP               
							,v_FCST_TYPE             
							,v_INCOTERMS             
							,v_MEASURE               
							,v_YYYYMM                
							,v_QTY                   
							,v_DEPT_ID               
							,v_BIZ_TYPE              
							,v_CELL_PROD_SITE		 
							,v_CURRENCY              
							,v_CREATED_BY            
							,v_LAST_UPDATED_BY   
							,v_CNT
					   ) VALUES ( 
							 @v_active_flag           	
							,@v_DIVISION_ID           
							,@v_VERSION_NO            
							,@v_PROJECT_CODE          
							,@v_SCM_SITE_ID           
							,@v_END_CUSTOMER          
							,@v_PLANT_SITE_ID         
							,@v_ITEM_ID               
							,@v_DOM_EXP               
							,@v_FCST_TYPE             
							,@v_INCOTERMS             
							,@v_MEASURE               
							,@v_YYYYMM                
							,@v_QTY                   
							,@v_DEPT_ID               
							,@v_BIZ_TYPE              
							,@v_CELL_PROD_SITE		  
							,@v_CURRENCY              
							,@v_CREATED_BY            
							,@v_LAST_UPDATED_BY          
							,0          
					   )  
                  END  

            END  
    END
	     
    PRINT ( 'A2_1--##TEMP_RESULTS  CNT ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETDATE(), 121))

	/* 대상건 있으면 처리 */
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1
    			 FROM #TEMP_RESULTS WITH (NOLOCK)  
              )
    BEGIN 
	
	
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C', N'U') IS NOT NULL	DROP TABLE #TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C
        IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#TEMP_RESULTS_DISTINCT', N'U') IS NOT NULL	DROP TABLE #TEMP_RESULTS_DISTINCT
		/*
		  대상데이타 템프저장
		*/   
		BEGIN
		    SELECT A.* 
			     , 'S' AS CRUD_CD
		      INTO #TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C 
			  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT 
			               v_DIVISION_ID
			             , v_VERSION_NO 
			             , v_PLANT_SITE_ID
			             , v_ITEM_ID
			          FROM #TEMP_RESULTS  WITH(NOLOCK)
				   ) B 
				 , DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C A WITH(NOLOCK)  
			  WHERE A.DIVISION_ID   =  B.v_DIVISION_ID
				AND A.VERSION_NO    =  B.v_VERSION_NO   
				AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.v_PLANT_SITE_ID 
				AND A.ITEM_ID       = B.v_ITEM_ID   
		END
   
        PRINT ( 'A3--##TEMP_RESULTS  CNT ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETDATE(), 121))
		  
		/*
		  건수체크/중복제거용 파일생성
		*/
		BEGIN
			UPDATE B 
			   SET v_CNT = v_CNT + 1 
			  FROM #TEMP_RESULTS  B 
				 , #TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C A WITH(NOLOCK)  
			  WHERE A.DIVISION_ID =  B.v_DIVISION_ID
				AND A.VERSION_NO  =  B.v_VERSION_NO 
				AND A.PROJECT_CODE = CASE WHEN (B.v_DIVISION_ID = '40')

THEN  A.PROJECT_CODE  ELSE  B.v_PROJECT_CODE  END 
				AND A.END_CUSTOMER = B.v_END_CUSTOMER
				AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = B.v_SCM_SITE_ID 
				AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.v_PLANT_SITE_ID 
				AND A.ITEM_ID = B.v_ITEM_ID 
				AND A.FCST_TYPE = B.v_FCST_TYPE 
				AND A.DOM_EXP = B.v_DOM_EXP 
				AND A.INCOTERMS = B.v_INCOTERMS 
				AND A.CURRENCY = B.v_CURRENCY  
				AND A.MEASURE      = B.v_MEASURE
				AND A.YYYYMM       = B.v_YYYYMM
				AND A.CELL_PROD_SITE = B.v_CELL_PROD_SITE			
			 
			SELECT	 DISTINCT 			       
					 v_DIVISION_ID           
					,v_VERSION_NO            
					,v_PROJECT_CODE          
					,v_SCM_SITE_ID           
					,v_END_CUSTOMER          
					,v_PLANT_SITE_ID         
					,v_ITEM_ID               
					,v_DOM_EXP               
					,v_FCST_TYPE             
					,v_INCOTERMS          
					,v_YYYYMM 
					,v_BIZ_TYPE              
					,v_CELL_PROD_SITE		 
					,v_CURRENCY              
					,v_CREATED_BY            
					,v_LAST_UPDATED_BY    
			  INTO #TEMP_RESULTS_DISTINCT   
			  FROM #TEMP_RESULTS WITH(NOLOCK)  
		END
			 
    --SELECT *
	--FROM #TEMP_RESULTS_DISTINCT

    PRINT ( 'A4--#TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETDATE(), 121))
	
		/*
		  MEASURE:'Business_Plan_Conf','BizPlanPrice_Cur' 대상이 없으면 INSERT
		*/				
							 
	IF (SELECT COUNT(1)  
		  FROM #TEMP_RESULTS  WITH(NOLOCK)
		 WHERE v_MEASURE IN ('Business_Plan_Conf','BizPlanPrice_Cur')
		   AND v_CNT = 0	
	   ) > 0
		BEGIN
			IF OBJECT_ID(N'tempdb..#TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C_I', N'U') IS NOT NULL	DROP TABLE #TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C_I
	
			SELECT T1.SEQ,DIVISION_ID,VERSION_NO,CUTOFF_TYPE,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD,DEPT_ID,PROJECT_CODE,SCM_SITE_ID,ITEM_ID 
				 , END_CUSTOMER,BIZ_TYPE,PLANT_SITE_ID,FCST_TYPE,DOM_EXP,INCOTERMS,ITEM_USE,UNIT_ENERGY,CURRENCY
				 , MEASURE, YYYYMM,QTY,PROJECT_NAME,CELL_PROD_SITE,EE_CORP_ID,CELL_CORP_ID,PACK_CORP_ID,EXT_INT 
				 , PRODUCT_GROUP,ALT_SIM_YN,CELL_CODE,CELL_PER_MODULE,MODULE_PER_PACK,CELL_PER_PACK,PERIOD_YYMM 
				 , SCENARIO_TYPE,BASE_PRICE,METAL_LINK_PRICE,METAL_LINK_YN,WORK_YYYYMMDD,OSP_YN 
				 , CREATED_BY,CREATION_DATE,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,TRANSFER_FLAG 
			INTO #TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C_I
			FROM (
					SELECT 1 AS SEQ,DIVISION_ID,VERSION_NO,CUTOFF_TYPE,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD,DEPT_ID,PROJECT_CODE,SCM_SITE_ID,ITEM_ID 
								,END_CUSTOMER,BIZ_TYPE,PLANT_SITE_ID,FCST_TYPE,DOM_EXP,INCOTERMS,ITEM_USE,UNIT_ENERGY,CURRENCY
								,A.MEASURE AS MEASURE, B.v_YYYYMM AS YYYYMM, CAST(B.v_QTY AS NVARCHAR(100))   AS QTY 
								,PROJECT_NAME,ISNULL(CELL_PROD_SITE, '-') AS CELL_PROD_SITE,EE_CORP_ID,CELL_CORP_ID,PACK_CORP_ID,EXT_INT 
								,PRODUCT_GROUP,ALT_SIM_YN,CELL_CODE,CELL_PER_MODULE,MODULE_PER_PACK,CELL_PER_PACK,PERIOD_YYMM 
								,SCENARIO_TYPE,BASE_PRICE,METAL_LINK_PRICE,METAL_LINK_YN,WORK_YYYYMMDD,OSP_YN 
								,B.v_CREATED_BY AS CREATED_BY,CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE() , 120)AS CREATION_DATE,B.v_CREATED_BY AS LAST_UPDATED_BY 
								,CONVERT(VARCHAR, GETDATE(), 120) AS LAST_UPDATE_DATE,TRANSFER_FLAG
								, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY A.DIVISION_ID,A.VERSION_NO,A.SCM_SITE_ID,A.PLANT_SITE_ID,A.ITEM_ID,A.FCST_TYPE,A.DOM_EXP,A.INCOTERMS, A.PROJECT_CODE
														   , A.CURRENCY, A.END_CUSTOMER,A.MEASURE,A.CELL_PROD_SITE  ORDER BY A.YYYYMM DESC,A.SEQ,A.BIZ_TYPE,A.LAST_UPDATE_DATE) AS SEQ_NO 
					FROM #TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C A WITH(NOLOCK) 
					JOIN #TEMP_RESULTS B WITH(NOLOCK) 
						ON A.DIVISION_ID =  B.v_DIVISION_ID
						AND A.VERSION_NO  =  B.v_VERSION_NO 
						AND A.SCM_SITE_ID = CASE WHEN (B.v_DIVISION_ID = '81') THEN  B.v_SCM_SITE_ID  ELSE  A.SCM_SITE_ID   END 
						AND A.PLANT_SITE_ID = B.v_PLANT_SITE_ID 
						AND A.ITEM_ID = B.v_ITEM_ID 
						AND A.FCST_TYPE = B.v_FCST_TYPE 
						AND A.DOM_EXP = B.v_DOM_EXP 
						AND A.INCOTERMS = B.v_INCOTERMS 
						AND A.CURRENCY = B.v_CURRENCY 
						AND A.PROJECT_CODE = CASE WHEN (B.v_DIVISION_ID = '40') THEN  A.PROJECT_CODE  ELSE  B.v_PROJECT_CODE

END    
						AND A.END_CUSTOMER = B.v_END_CUSTOMER
						AND A.MEASURE      = B.v_MEASURE
						AND ISNULL(A.CELL_PROD_SITE, '-') = ISNULL(B.v_CELL_PROD_SITE, '-')
						AND A.MEASURE      IN ('Business_Plan_Conf','BizPlanPrice_Cur')
				 WHERE B.v_CNT = 0	 
				   AND B.v_MEASURE IN ('Business_Plan_Conf','BizPlanPrice_Cur')
			)  T1 
			WHERE T1.SEQ_NO = 1
	

			INSERT INTO #TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C (
						SEQ,DIVISION_ID,VERSION_NO,CUTOFF_TYPE,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD,DEPT_ID,PROJECT_CODE,SCM_SITE_ID,ITEM_ID
						,END_CUSTOMER,BIZ_TYPE,PLANT_SITE_ID,FCST_TYPE,DOM_EXP,INCOTERMS,ITEM_USE,UNIT_ENERGY,CURRENCY
						,MEASURE,YYYYMM,QTY
						,PROJECT_NAME,CELL_PROD_SITE,EE_CORP_ID,CELL_CORP_ID,PACK_CORP_ID,EXT_INT
						,PRODUCT_GROUP,ALT_SIM_YN,CELL_CODE,CELL_PER_MODULE,MODULE_PER_PACK,CELL_PER_PACK,PERIOD_YYMM
						,SCENARIO_TYPE,BASE_PRICE,METAL_LINK_PRICE,METAL_LINK_YN,WORK_YYYYMMDD,OSP_YN
						,CREATED_BY,CREATION_DATE,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,TRANSFER_FLAG,CRUD_CD		
						)  
			SELECT       SEQ,DIVISION_ID,VERSION_NO,CUTOFF_TYPE,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD,DEPT_ID,PROJECT_CODE,SCM_SITE_ID,ITEM_ID 
						,END_CUSTOMER,BIZ_TYPE,PLANT_SITE_ID,FCST_TYPE,DOM_EXP,INCOTERMS,ITEM_USE,UNIT_ENERGY,CURRENCY
						,MEASURE, YYYYMM, QTY 
						,PROJECT_NAME,CELL_PROD_SITE,EE_CORP_ID,CELL_CORP_ID,PACK_CORP_ID,EXT_INT 
						,PRODUCT_GROUP,ALT_SIM_YN,CELL_CODE,CELL_PER_MODULE,MODULE_PER_PACK,CELL_PER_PACK,PERIOD_YYMM 
						,SCENARIO_TYPE,BASE_PRICE,METAL_LINK_PRICE,METAL_LINK_YN,WORK_YYYYMMDD,OSP_YN 
						,CREATED_BY,CREATION_DATE,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,TRANSFER_FLAG
			            , 'I' AS CRUD_CD		
			 FROM #TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C_I WITH(NOLOCK)
		END	

			 

    PRINT ( 'A5--SalesAmt_CUR INSERT ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETDATE(), 121))
		/*
		  MEASURE:'SalesAmt_CUR','BizPlanPrice_KRW', 대상이 없으면 INSERT
		*/ 			
	IF (SELECT COUNT(1)  
		  FROM #TEMP_RESULTS WITH(NOLOCK)
		 WHERE v_CNT = 0	
	   ) > 0
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO #TEMP_DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C (
						SEQ,DIVISION_ID,VERSION_NO,CUTOFF_TYPE,CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD,DEPT_ID,PROJECT_CODE,SCM_SITE_ID,ITEM_ID
						,END_CUSTOMER,BIZ_TYPE,PLANT_SITE_ID,FCST_TYPE,DOM_EXP,INCOTERMS,ITEM_USE,UNIT_ENERGY,CURRENCY
						,MEASURE,YYYYMM,QTY
						,PROJECT_NAME,CELL_PROD_SITE,EE_CORP_ID,CELL_CORP_ID,PACK_CORP_ID,EXT_INT
						,PRODUCT_GROUP,ALT_SIM_YN,CELL_CODE,CELL_PER_MODULE,MODULE_PER_PACK,CELL_PER_PACK,PERIOD_YYMM
						,SCENARIO_TYPE,BASE_PRICE,METAL_LINK_PRICE,METAL_LINK_YN,WORK_YYYYMMDD,OSP_YN
						,CREATED_BY,CREATION_DATE,LAST_UPDATED_BY,LAST_UPDATE_DATE,TRANSFER_FLAG,CRUD_CD		
						)

					, '[Q_' + REPLACE(A.CALENDAR_YYYYQQ, 'Q', '_') + ']' AS PV_NAME

OM #TMP_RTF WITH(NOLOCK)

/*작업전 백업*/

	SET ANSI_NULLS ON

	SET NOCOUNT ON;

	SET ANSI_WARNINGS ON;

	DECLARE	@i_count	int	= 0;


    DECLARE @v_dept_id	nvarchar(50)='';
	DECLARE @v_group_id nvarchar(50)='';

	DECLARE @v_user_mea_cnt int =0;

	
    PRINT ( 'A1--@v_dept_id ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETDATE(), 121))

	-- 사용자의 팀정보 & 권한
	SELECT @v_dept_id = isnull	( 
								(	select TOP 1 SEGMENT3

	WHERE  U.UserID = @p_created_by

		END

	--------

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

		;
		/*
	IF OBJECT_ID (N'tempdb..#TEMP_SCM_MST_SITE', N'U') IS NOT NULL

		*/

		; 
	IF OBJECT_ID (N'tempdb..#TEMP_SCM_CITY', N'U') IS NOT NULL 
		DROP TABLE #TEMP_SCM_CITY
		;
	IF OBJECT_ID (N'tempdb..#T_PRICE', N'U') IS NOT NULL 
		DROP TABLE #T_PRICE
		;
	IF OBJECT_ID (N'tempdb..#T_COLUMN_SETUP', N'U') IS NOT NULL 
		DROP TABLE #T_COLUMN_SETUP
		;
	IF OBJECT_ID (N'tempdb..#T', N'U') IS NOT NULL 
		DROP TABLE #T
		;
	IF OBJECT_ID (N'tempdb..#WF', N'U') IS NOT NULL 
		DROP TABLE #WF
		;

		 
    PRINT ( 'A2--@v_user_mea_cnt ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETDATE(), 121))

		SELECT @v_user_mea_cnt = COUNT(*)
			FROM   [DBO].[SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER] U WITH(NOLOCK)
				WHERE  1 = 1
				AND    U.PROGRAM_ID						= @p_program_id
				AND    U.SHEET_NAME						= @p_sheet_name
				AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE	= 'M'
				AND    U.USER_ID						= @p_created_by;

		IF @v_user_mea_cnt = 0
		BEGIN	    
			INSERT INTO [dbo].[SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER]
			( USER_ID
			, PROGRAM_ID
			, SHEET_NAME
			, USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE
			, COLUMN_NAME
			, SORT_ORDER_NO
			, SUB_TOTAL_FLAG
			, DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
			, CREATED_BY
			, CREATION_DATE
			, LAST_UPDATED_BY
			, LAST_UPDATE_DATE
			)
			SELECT @p_created_by
					, C.PROGRAM_ID
					, C.SHEET_NAME
					, 'M'
					, C.COLUMN_NAME
					, C.SORT_ORDER_NO
					, 'N'
					, ''
					, @p_created_by
					, CONVERT(varchar(19), GETDATE(), 121)
					, @p_created_by
					, CONVERT(varchar(19), GETDATE(), 121)

			WHERE  1 = 1

			AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = @p_sheet_name
			AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
			AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'	;
		END;

		SELECT DISTINCT
				  U.PROGRAM_ID
				, U.SHEET_NAME
				, U.COLUMN_NAME AS MEASURE
				, U.SORT_ORDER_NO
		INTO #SELECT_MEASURE
		FROM [dbo].[SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER] U  WITH(NOLOCK)
			WHERE 1 = 1
			AND U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'M'
			AND U.PROGRAM_ID	= @p_program_id
			AND U.SHEET_NAME	= @p_sheet_name
			AND U.USER_ID		= @p_created_by

--SELECT * FROM #SELECT_MEASURE

		VERSION_NO			NVARCHAR(30)
		, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD	CHAR(8)
		, DIVISION_ID		NVARCHAR(30)
		, PROJECT_CODE		NVARCHAR(50)
		, SCM_SITE_ID		NVARCHAR(30)
		, PLANT_SITE_ID		NVARCHAR(30)
		, ITEM_ID			NVARCHAR(50)
		, INCOTERMS			NVARCHAR(10)
		, CELL_PROD_SITE	NVARCHAR(30)
		, FCST_TYPE			NVARCHAR(20)
		, DOM_EXP			NVARCHAR(2)
		, CURRENCY			NVARCHAR(3)
		, COMPANY_ID		NVARCHAR(30)
		, MEASURE			NVARCHAR(50)
		, YYYYMM			CHAR(6)
		, CAL_YYYYQQ		NVARCHAR(6)
		, CAL_YYYY			NVARCHAR(4)

		, VALID_YN			CHAR(1)

		, DEPT_ID			NVARCHAR(50)
		, END_CUSTOMER		NVARCHAR(50)
		, BIZ_TYPE			NVARCHAR(30)
		, PROJECT_NAME		NVARCHAR(50)
		,ITEM_USE			NVARCHAR(100)   
        ,UNIT_ENERGY		NVARCHAR(100)
--사업계획3차 수정[컬럼추가] CELL_PER_PACK, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8 [START]
		,CELL_CODE          NVARCHAR(100)
		,CELL_PER_PACK      NVARCHAR(100)
		,ATTRIBUTE5         NVARCHAR(100)
		,ATTRIBUTE6         NVARCHAR(100)
		,ATTRIBUTE7         NVARCHAR(100)
		,ATTRIBUTE8         NVARCHAR(100)
--사업계획3차 수정[컬럼추가] CELL_PER_PACK, ATTRIBUTE5, ATTRIBUTE6, ATTRIBUTE7, ATTRIBUTE8 [END]

,EDIT_FLAG			NVARCHAR(2)
		,TRANSFER_FLAG		NVARCHAR(2)
		)


    PRINT ( 'A3--#TEMP_SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETDATE(), 121))

		-- SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO 임시테이블 생성
		SELECT DEPT_ID, USER_ID
		INTO #TEMP_SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO
		FROM SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO WITH(NOLOCK)
			ORDER BY USER_ID 


		-- SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM 임시테이블 생성
		/*
		SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY, CUST_GROUP
			, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, ROUTE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE5
			, REPORT_GROUP1, REPORT_GROUP2, REPORT_GROUP3, REPORT_GROUP4, REPORT_GROUP5
			, REPORT_GROUP6, OWNER, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE
			, DBO.FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME (SMSI.OWNER, ',', 'EN' )                AS OWNER_NAME
			, DBO.FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME (SMSI.OWNER, ',', 'KO' )                AS OWNER_NAME_KO
			,( SELECT SU.DEPT_ID  
			   FROM #TEMP_SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU WITH(NOLOCK) 
			   WHERE SU.USER_ID = (SELECT top 1 token FROM [dbo].[String_Split](SMSI.owner, ',')) 
			 ) AS DEPT_ID
		INTO #TEMP_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
		FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SMSI WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE 1=1 
		AND SMSI.Division_id = @p_division_id
		AND SMSI.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID FROM DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C  WITH(NOLOCK)  WHERE DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id AND VERSION_NO IN (SELECT LEFT(token,  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('(',token) = 0 THEN LEN(token) ELSE CHARINDEX('(',token)-1 END ) FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_version_type ,',')) )


		SELECT *
		INTO #TEMP_SCM_MST_SITE
		FROM SCM_MST_SITE A WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE A.Division_id = @p_division_id


		SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY, CUST_GROUP
			, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, ROUTE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE5
			, REPORT_GROUP1, REPORT_GROUP2, REPORT_GROUP3, REPORT_GROUP4, REPORT_GROUP5
			, REPORT_GROUP6, OWNER, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE
			, DBO.FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME (SMSI.OWNER, ',', 'EN' )                AS OWNER_NAME
			, DBO.FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME (SMSI.OWNER, ',', 'KO' )                AS OWNER_NAME_KO
			, (SELECT top 1 token FROM [dbo].[String_Split](SMSI.owner, ',')) AS OWNER1
		INTO #TEMP_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM1
		FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SMSI WITH(NOLOCK) 
		WHERE 1=1 
		AND SMSI.Division_id = @p_division_id
		AND SMSI.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID FROM DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C  WITH(NOLOCK)  WHERE DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id AND VERSION_NO IN (SELECT LEFT(token,  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('(',token) = 0 THEN LEN(token) ELSE CHARINDEX('(',token)-1 END ) FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_version_type ,',')) )

		*/
		
		/* DEPT_ID를 가져올때 select 절에서 가져오는 로직을 수정함(속도개선)-20240215 kcw3408	*/
		SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY, CUST_GROUP
			, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, ROUTE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE5
			, REPORT_GROUP1, REPORT_GROUP2, REPORT_GROUP3, REPORT_GROUP4, REPORT_GROUP5
			, REPORT_GROUP6, OWNER, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE
			, OWNER_NAME
			, OWNER_NAME_KO
			, SU.DEPT_ID  AS DEPT_ID
		INTO #TEMP_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM
		FROM ( SELECT DIVISION_ID, SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, ITEM_ID, CURRENCY, CUST_GROUP
					, CUST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, ROUTE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE5
					, REPORT_GROUP1, REPORT_GROUP2, REPORT_GROUP3, REPORT_GROUP4, REPORT_GROUP5
					, REPORT_GROUP6, OWNER, CELL_PER_CAR, CELL_PER_MODULE
					, DBO.FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME (SMSI.OWNER, ',', 'EN' )                AS OWNER_NAME
					, DBO.FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME (SMSI.OWNER, ',', 'KO' )                AS OWNER_NAME_KO
					, (SELECT top 1 token FROM [dbo].[String_Split](SMSI.owner, ',')) AS OWNER1 
				FROM SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SMSI WITH(NOLOCK) 
				WHERE 1=1 
				AND SMSI.Division_id = @p_division_id
				AND SMSI.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID FROM DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C  WITH(NOLOCK)  WHERE DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id AND VERSION_NO IN (SELECT LEFT(token,  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('(',token) = 0 THEN LEN(token) ELSE CHARINDEX('(',token)-1 END ) FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_version_type

,',')) )
            ) SMSI   
		LEFT JOIN #TEMP_SCM_MST_SSO_USER_INFO SU WITH(NOLOCK) 
		           ON SU.USER_ID = SMSI.owner1
		WHERE 1=1 
		
    PRINT ( 'A4--#RAW_DATA ' + CONVERT(NVARCHAR(30), GETDATE(), 121))

		--CURRENT버전
		IF ( @p_version_type LIKE '%CURRENT%' )
		BEGIN 
			--MONTHLY
			INSERT INTO #RAW_DATA ( VERSION_NO, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
									, INCOTERMS, CELL_PROD_SITE, FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CURRENCY, MEASURE, YYYYMM, CAL_YYYYQQ, CAL_YYYY, QTY
									, COLNAME, DEPT_ID, END_CUSTOMER, BIZ_TYPE, PROJECT_NAME, A.ITEM_USE, A.UNIT_ENERGY)--, EDIT_FLAG, TRANSFER_FLAG )
			SELECT   'CURRENT' AS VERSION_NO
					, NULL AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
					, A.DIVISION_ID 
					,A.PROJECT_CODE 
					,A.SCM_SITE_ID 
					,PLANT_SITE_ID 
					,A.ITEM_ID 
					,A.INCOTERMS 
					,A.CELL_PROD_SITE 
					,A.FCST_TYPE 
					,A.DOM_EXP
					,A.CURRENCY
					,A.MEASURE
					,A.YYYYMM
					,CAL.CALENDAR_YYYYQQ AS CAL_YYYYQQ
					,CAL.CALENDAR_YYYY AS CAL_YYYY
					,A.QTY
					,'M_' + A.YYYYMM AS COLNAME
					,A.DEPT_ID
					,A.END_CUSTOMER
					,A.BIZ_TYPE
					,A.PROJECT_NAME
					,A.ITEM_USE
					,A.UNIT_ENERGY
					--,CASE WHEN ( CASE WHEN A.DIVISION_ID = '40' THEN SI.DEPT_ID ELSE A.DEPT_ID END ) = @v_dept_id THEN 'Y'
					--      WHEN @v_group_id ='ADMIN' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EDIT_FLAG	--,A.EDIT_FLAG
					--, 'N' TRANSFER_FLAG
			FROM [DM_PLN_BIZPLAN] AS A WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN #SELECT_MEASURE B ON A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
			INNER JOIN (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY, CALENDAR_YYYYQQ, BASIS_YYYYMM 
						FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE (BASIS_YYYYMM >= SUBSTRING(@p_from_yyyymmdd, 1,6) AND BASIS_YYYYMM <= SUBSTRING(@p_to_yyyymmdd, 1,6))
						GROUP BY CALENDAR_YYYY, CALENDAR_YYYYQQ, BASIS_YYYYMM) AS CAL
					ON CAL.BASIS_YYYYMM = A.YYYYMM
			LEFT JOIN #TEMP_SCM_MST_SITE_ITEM SI WITH(NOLOCK)
						 ON A.DIVISION_ID		= SI.DIVISION_ID
						AND A.SCM_SITE_ID		= SI.SCM_SITE_ID
						AND A.PROJECT_CODE		= SI.PROJECT_CODE
						AND A.ITEM_ID			= SI.ITEM_ID
			WHERE A.YYYYMM >= SUBSTRING(@p_from_yyyymmdd, 1,6) and A.YYYYMM <= SUBSTRING(@p_to_yyyymmdd, 1,6)
				AND A.DIVISION_ID =@p_division_id
				ORDER BY B.SORT_ORDER_NO

			--QUATERLY
			INSERT INTO #RAW_DATA ( VERSION_NO, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
									, INCOTERMS, CELL_PROD_SITE, FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CURRENCY, MEASURE, YYYYMM, CAL_YYYYQQ, CAL_YYYY, QTY
									, COLNAME, DEPT_ID, END_CUSTOMER, BIZ_TYPE, PROJECT_NAME, A.ITEM_USE, A.UNIT_ENERGY)--, EDIT_FLAG, TRANSFER_FLAG )
			SELECT 'CURRENT' AS VERSION_NO
					, NULL AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
					, A.DIVISION_ID 
					, A.PROJECT_CODE 
					, A.SCM_SITE_ID 
					, A.PLANT_SITE_ID 
					, A.ITEM_ID 
					, A.INCOTERMS 
					, A.CELL_PROD_SITE 
					, A.FCST_TYPE
					, A.DOM_EXP
					, A.CURRENCY
					, A.MEASURE
					, A.CAL_YYYYQQ AS YYYYMM
					, A.CAL_YYYYQQ AS CAL_YYYYQQ
					, A.CAL_YYYY AS CAL_YYYY
					, CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_CUR' OR MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_KRW'OR MEASURE = 'Business_Plan'
					--, CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_KRW' OR MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_LOC' OR MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_USD' OR MEASURE = 'Business_Plan'
						THEN SUM(QTY)
						ELSE MAX(QTY) 
						END QTY
					, 'Q_' + REPLACE(A.CAL_YYYYQQ, 'Q', '_') AS COLNAME
					, A.DEPT_ID
					, MAX(A.END_CUSTOMER)
					, MAX(A.BIZ_TYPE)
					, MAX(A.PROJECT_NAME)
					, A.ITEM_USE
					, A.UNIT_ENERGY
					--, A.EDIT_FLAG
					--, ISNULL(A.TRANSFER_FLAG, 'N')
			FROM #RAW_DATA AS A
			GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID 
					, A.PROJECT_CODE 
					, A.SCM_SITE_ID 
					, PLANT_SITE_ID 
					, A.ITEM_ID 
					, A.INCOTERMS 
					, A.CELL_PROD_SITE 
					, A.FCST_TYPE 
					, A.DOM_EXP
					, A.CURRENCY
					, A.MEASURE
					, A.YYYYMM
					, A.CAL_YYYYQQ
					, A.CAL_YYYY
					, A.DEPT_ID
					, A.ITEM_USE
					, A.UNIT_ENERGY
					--, A.EDIT_FLAG
					--, A.

TRANSFER_FLAG

			--YEARLY
			INSERT INTO #RAW_DATA ( VERSION_NO, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
									, INCOTERMS, CELL_PROD_SITE, FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CURRENCY, MEASURE, YYYYMM, CAL_YYYYQQ, CAL_YYYY, QTY
									, COLNAME, DEPT_ID, END_CUSTOMER, BIZ_TYPE, PROJECT_NAME, A.ITEM_USE, A.UNIT_ENERGY)--, EDIT_FLAG, TRANSFER_FLAG )
			SELECT 'CURRENT' AS VERSION_NO
					, NULL AS CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD
					, A.DIVISION_ID 
					, A.PROJECT_CODE 
					, A.SCM_SITE_ID 
					, PLANT_SITE_ID 
					, A.ITEM_ID 
					, A.INCOTERMS 
					, A.CELL_PROD_SITE 
					, A.FCST_TYPE 
					, A.DOM_EXP
					, A.CURRENCY
					, A.MEASURE
					, A.CAL_YYYY AS YYYYMM
					, A.CAL_YYYY AS CAL_YYYYQQ
					, A.CAL_YYYY
					, CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_CUR' OR MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_KRW'OR MEASURE = 'Business_Plan'
					--, CASE WHEN MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_KRW' OR MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_LOC' OR MEASURE = 'SalesAmt_USD' OR MEASURE = 'Business_Plan'
						THEN SUM(QTY)
						ELSE MAX(QTY) 
						END QTY
					, 'Y_' + A.CAL_YYYY AS COLNAME
					, A.DEPT_ID
					, MAX(A.END_CUSTOMER)
					, MAX(A.BIZ_TYPE)
					, MAX(A.PROJECT_NAME)
					, A.ITEM_USE
					, A.UNIT_ENERGY
					--, A.EDIT_FLAG
					--, ISNULL(A.TRANSFER_FLAG, 'N')
			FROM #RAW_DATA AS A
			WHERE COLNAME LIKE 'Q_%'
			GROUP BY A.DIVISION_ID 
					, A.PROJECT_CODE 
					, A.SCM_SITE_ID 
					, PLANT_SITE_ID 
					, A.ITEM_ID 
					, A.INCOTERMS 
					, A.CELL_PROD_SITE 
					, A.FCST_TYPE 
					, A.DOM_EXP
					, A.CURRENCY
					, A.MEASURE
					, A.YYYYMM

		 , A.PACK_CORP_ID
		 , A.OSP_YN		
		 , A.MEASURE
		 , A.YYYYMM
		 , A.QTY
	  INTO #DATA_40
	  FROM dbo.DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C A 
	 WHERE 1=1
	   AND A.DIVISION_ID	= @p_division_id

	   --AND A.INCOTERMS	    = @p_incoterms
	   AND A.YYYYMM		    BETWEEN @p_from_yyyymm and @p_to_yyyymm

	SET @Query = '';
	UPDATE #DATA_40 SET MEASURE = 'Business Plan(Conf.)'

		   AND MEASURE = 'Business Plan(Conf.)'
	GROUP BY YYYYMM) A;

	SET @Query = LEFT(@Query, LEN(@Query)-1);

	---- 실행
	EXEC ('SELECT * FROM

						   FROM #DATA_40

						 AS RESULT  PIVOT ( SUM(QTY) FOR YYYYMM IN (' + @Query + ') ) AS PIVOT_RESULT

	( SELECT SCM_SITE_ID, PROJECT_CODE, PROJECT_NAME, ITEM_ID, ITEM_NICKNAME, FCST_TYPE, EE_CORP_ID, CELL_CORP_ID, PACK_CORP_ID, OSP_YN, MEASURE, YYYYMM, QTY from DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C)

N'U') IS NOT NULL 	DROP TABLE #TEMP_SCP_ANL_BUSINESS_PLAN_RTF_DM

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[DMF0051_1_GET_SPREAD_TITLE_20240321]
    @p_start_yyyymmdd		NVARCHAR(8),

								   END)

							THEN (CASE WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' THEN REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','') + '*'
									   ELSE REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','')
								   END) 
					   ELSE C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME END		 AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
				-- [C20221107-000343]BP Waterfall 오류 수정 요청의 건
				, U.SORT_ORDER_NO
				, C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
				, C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
				, C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
				, '' AS DAY_CODE
				, C.FIXED_FLAG
				, C.COLUMN_WIDTH
				, C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
				, C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
				, C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
				, C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
				, C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
				, C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
				, C.VISIBLE_FLAG
				, C.DEFAULT_FLAG
				, C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
				, C.VALID_YN
				, C.DIVISION_ID
				, @p_division_id as ATTRIBUTE1
				, CASE WHEN CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE = 'DM_LOOKUP_DIV' THEN C.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE '' END AS ATTRIBUTE2
				, '' as ATTRIBUTE3
				, C.ATTRIBUTE4
				, C.ATTRIBUTE5
		FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_TITLESET_USER] U WITH(NOLOCK)
				, [dbo].[SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS] C WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE  1 = 1
		AND    U.PROGRAM_ID  = C.PROGRAM_ID
		AND    U.SHEET_NAME  = C.SHEET_NAME
		AND    U.COLUMN_NAME = C.COLUMN_NAME
		AND    U.PROGRAM_ID  = @v_program_id
		AND    U.SHEET_NAME  = @v_sheet_name
		AND    U.USER_ID     = @p_created_by
		AND    U.USER_INQUIRY_COLUMN_TYPE_CODE = 'C'
		AND	 @p_division_id IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(C.DIVISION_ID ,',') )		
		UNION ALL
		SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
				, C.SHEET_NAME
				, C.COLUMN_NAME
				, CASE WHEN @P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' 
							THEN (CASE WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE4 = 'Y' THEN REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','') + '*'
									   ELSE REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','')
								   END)
					   WHEN @P_DIVISION_ID = '82' 
							THEN (CASE WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' THEN REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','') + '*'
									   ELSE REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','')
								   END) 
					   ELSE C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME END		 AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME 
				, C.SORT_ORDER_NO
				, C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
				, C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
				, C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
				, '' AS DAY_CODE
				, C.FIXED_FLAG
				, C.COLUMN_WIDTH
				, C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
				, C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
				, C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
				, C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
				, C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
				, C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
				, C.VISIBLE_FLAG
				, C.DEFAULT_FLAG
				, C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
				, C.VALID_YN
				, C.DIVISION_ID
				, @p_division_id as ATTRIBUTE1	
				, C.ATTRIBUTE2
				, C.ATTRIBUTE3
				, C.ATTRIBUT

E4
				, C.ATTRIBUTE5
		FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS] C WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE  1 = 1    
		AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = @v_program_id
		AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = @v_sheet_name
		AND    C.VISIBLE_FLAG = 'N'
		AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = ''
		AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'
		AND	 @p_division_id IN (SELECT token FROM dbo.String_Split(C.DIVISION_ID ,',') )		-- 20180620 division 추가

		UNION ALL

		SELECT @v_program_id   AS PROGRAM_ID
				, @v_sheet_name AS SHEET_NAME
				, T.COLUMN_NAME
				, T.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
				, T.SORT_ORDER_NO
				, ''         AS DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
				, T.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
				, T.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
				, '' AS DAY_CODE
				, ''         AS FIXED_FLAG
				, 100         AS COLUMN_WIDTH
				, 'FPNumber' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
				--, '' AS CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
				, ''         AS CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
				, '3'        AS DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
				, ''         AS DATA_MAX_LENGTH
				, 'R'        AS HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
				, 'Y'        AS UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
				, 'Y'        AS VISIBLE_FLAG
				, ''         AS DEFAULT_FLAG
				, ''         AS USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
				, ''         AS VALID_YN
				, ''		 AS DIVISION_ID
				, '' AS ATTRIBUTE1
				, '' AS ATTRIBUTE2
				, '' AS ATTRIBUTE3
				, '' AS ATTRIBUTE4
				, '' AS ATTRIBUTE5
		FROM  (
			SELECT * FROM (
				-- Monthly
				SELECT 		
						'M_' + A.BASIS_YYYYMM  AS COLUMN_NAME
						, A.MONTH_NAME          AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
						, 'Q' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEPART(QUARTER, A.BASIS_YYYYMM + '01'))          AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
						, A.CALENDAR_YYYY          AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
						, BASIS_YYYYMM + '01' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
				FROM    [dbo].[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] A WITH(NOLOCK)	
				WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= @p_start_yyyymmdd
				AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= @p_end_yyyymmdd
				GROUP BY 
						CALENDAR_YYYY
						, A.BASIS_YYYYMM
						, A.MONTH_NAME
				UNION ALL
				-- Quarterly
				SELECT 
					DISTINCT
					'Q_' + CALENDAR_YYYY + '_' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEPART(QUARTER, A.BASIS_YYYYMM + '01')) AS COLUMN_NAME
					, 'Q' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEPART(QUARTER, A.BASIS_YYYYMM + '01')) AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
					, 'Q' + CONVERT(VARCHAR, DATEPART(QUARTER, A.BASIS_YYYYMM + '01')) AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
					, CALENDAR_YYYY AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME					
					, CASE 
						WHEN DATEPART(QUARTER, A.BASIS_YYYYMM + '01') = 1 THEN CALENDAR_YYYY + '0100'
						WHEN DATEPART(QUARTER, A.BASIS_YYYYMM + '01') = 2 THEN CALENDAR_YYYY + '0400'
						WHEN DATEPART(QUARTER, A.BASIS_YYYYMM + '01') = 3 THEN CALENDAR_YYYY + '0700'
						ELSE CALENDAR_YYYY + '1000' END AS SORT_ORDER_NO
				FROM    [dbo].[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] A WITH(NOLOCK)	
				WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= @p_start_yyyymmdd
				AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= @p_end_yyyymmdd

				UNION ALL
				-- Yearly
				SELECT 
					DISTINCT
					'Y_' + CALENDAR_YYYY AS COLUMN_NAME
					, CALENDAR_YYYY	AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
					, CALENDAR_YYYY	AS SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
					, CALENDAR_YYYY	AS LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
					, CALENDAR_YYYY + '0000' AS SORT_ORDER_NO
				FROM    [dbo].[SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M] A WITH(NOLOCK)	
				WHERE  A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD >= @p_start_yyyymmdd
				AND    A.BASIS_YYYYMMDD <= @p_end_yyyymmdd
			) MA 
		) T
		ORDER BY SORT_ORDER_NO   ;
		
	    END;

	ELSE
		BEGIN		
		SELECT C.PROGRAM_ID
				, C.SHEET_NAME
				, C.COLUMN_NAME
				, CASE WHEN @P_DIVISION_ID LIKE '81%' 
							THEN (CASE WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE4 = 'Y' THEN REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','') + '*'
									   ELSE REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','')
								   END)
					   WHEN @P_DIVISION_ID = '82' 
							THEN (CASE WHEN C.ATTRIBUTE5 = 'Y' THEN REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','') + '*'
									   ELSE REPLACE(C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME,'*','')
								   END) 
					   ELSE C.COLUMN_LABEL_NAME END		 AS COLUMN_LABEL_NAME
				, C.SORT_ORDER_NO
				, C.DATA_SORT_METHOD_CODE
				, C.SMALL_CLASS_LABEL_NAME
				, C.LARGE_CLASS_LABEL_NAME

, '' AS DAY_CODE
				, C.FIXED_FLAG
				, C.COLUMN_WIDTH
				, C.CELL_CONTROL_OBJECT_TYPE_CODE
				, C.CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE
				, C.DATA_SCALE_NUMBER
				, C.DATA_MAX_LENGTH
				, C.HORIZONTAL_ALIGN_CODE
				, C.UPPERCASE_APPLY_FLAG
				, C.VISIBLE_FLAG
				, C.DEFAULT_FLAG
				, C.USER_SELECTABLE_FLAG
				, C.VALID_YN
				, C.DIVISION_ID
				, @p_division_id as ATTRIBUTE1	
				, CASE WHEN CELL_COMBO_DATA_TYPE = 'DM_LOOKUP_DIV' THEN C.ATTRIBUTE1 ELSE '' END AS ATTRIBUTE2
				, '' as ATTRIBUTE3
				, C.ATTRIBUTE4
				, C.ATTRIBUTE5
		FROM   [dbo].[SCM_MST_SHEET_COLUMNS] C WITH(NOLOCK)
		WHERE  1 = 1    
		AND    C.PROGRAM_ID  = @v_program_id
		AND    C.SHEET_NAME  = @v_sheet_name
		AND    C.DEFAULT_FLAG = 'Y'
		AND    C.VALID_YN     = 'Y'

			, DBO.FN_GET_DM_MKT_OWNER_NAME (SMSI.OWNER, ',', 'EN' )                AS OWNER_NAME

			,( SELECT SU.DEPT_ID

		WHERE 1=1 
		AND SMSI.Division_id = @p_division_id
		AND SMSI.ITEM_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ITEM_ID FROM DM_PLN_BIZPLAN_C  WITH(NOLOCK)  WHERE DIVISION_ID = @p_division_id AND VERSION_NO IN (SELECT LEFT(token,  CASE WHEN CHARINDEX('(',token) = 0 THEN LEN(token) ELSE CHARINDEX('(',token)-1 END ) FROM dbo.String_Split(@p_version_type ,',')) )

UST_GROUP_DTL, APPLICATION, ROUTE, ATTRIBUTE1, ATTRIBUTE2, ATTRIBUTE5

            ) SMSI

		--CURRENT버전
		IF ( @p_version_type LIKE '%CURRENT%' )
		BEGIN 
			--MONTHLY
			INSERT INTO #RAW_DATA ( VERSION_NO, CUTOFF_YYYYMMDD, DIVISION_ID, PROJECT_CODE, SCM_SITE_ID, PLANT_SITE_ID, ITEM_ID
									, INCOTERMS, CELL_PROD_SITE, FCST_TYPE, DOM_EXP, CURRENCY, MEASURE, YYYYMM, CAL_YYYYQQ, CAL_YYYY, QTY

					,A.MEASURE

					,CAL.CALENDAR_YYYY AS CAL_YYYY
					,A.QTY

					,A.END_CUSTOMER

			FROM [DM_PLN_BIZPLAN] AS A WITH(NOLOCK)
			JOIN #SELECT_MEASURE B ON A.MEASURE = B.MEASURE
			INNER JOIN (SELECT CALENDAR_YYYY, CALENDAR_YYYYQQ, BASIS_YYYYMM 
						FROM SCM_SYS_CALENDAR_M WITH(NOLOCK)
						WHERE (BASIS_YYYYMM >= SUBSTRING(@p_from_yyyymmdd, 1,6) AND BASIS_YYYYMM <= SUBSTRING(@p_to_yyyymmdd, 1,6))
